name: Arcane Duelist
summary: A martial bard who blends weapon mastery, protective performance, and arcane spellcraft.

features.name: Arcane Strike
features.summary: Gain Arcane Strike as a bonus feat.

features.name: Rallying Cry
features.summary: Use an Intimidate check in place of nearby allies' saving throws against fear and despair, allowing a new save each round.

features.name: Bladethirst +1
features.summary: Grant one nearby weapon, natural weapon, double-weapon end, or ammunition group a +1 enhancement bonus or qualifying weapon properties.

features.name: Mass Bladethirst
features.summary: Extend Bladethirst to multiple allies, granting an identical bonus that scales from +4 for two allies to +1 for five or more.

features.name: Combat Casting
features.summary: Gain Combat Casting as a bonus feat.

features.name: Disruptive
features.summary: Gain Disruptive as a bonus feat without needing to meet its normal Fighter prerequisite.

features.name: Spellbreaker
features.summary: Gain Spellbreaker as a bonus feat without needing to meet its normal Fighter prerequisite.

features.name: Penetrating Strike
features.summary: Gain Penetrating Strike as a bonus feat without needing to meet its normal Fighter prerequisite.

features.name: Greater Penetrating Strike
features.summary: Gain Greater Penetrating Strike as a bonus feat without needing to meet its normal Fighter prerequisite.

features.name: Arcane Bond
features.summary: Bond with a weapon and cast one additional known spell once per day; the bonded-weapon hand can provide somatic components.

features.name: Arcane Armor: Medium
features.summary: Gain Medium Armor Proficiency and cast bard spells in medium armor without arcane spell failure.

features.name: Arcane Armor: Heavy
features.summary: Gain Heavy Armor Proficiency and cast bard spells in heavy armor without arcane spell failure.
